column1: # GHGA monorepo import manifest
# Source of truth for the history-preserving import + one-way sync.
# Columns (TAB-separated): kind  source_repo  subpath  dest_path  branch
#   kind        one of: lib | service | tool | testbed
#   source_repo repo name under github.com/ghga-de (and dir name in .legacy_repos/)
#   subpath     "." for whole repo, or a subdir for repos imported partially (as
#               file-services-backend was, before its rows were retired)
#   dest_path   destination path within the monorepo
#   branch      upstream branch to track (default main). Some repos have a different *compatible*
#               branch than main — e.g. ghga-transpiler's integrated line is v2, not main (3.x).
# Excluded on purpose:
#   datahub-test-bed                  -> different audience (data hubs verifying their own S3); stays its own repo
#   microservice-repository-template  -> RETIRED; its conventions become root scaffolding, not imported
#   upload-orchestration-service      -> DEPRECATED upstream; never imported. ARCHIVED 2026-09-09,
#                                        so nothing here tracks it and nothing ever will.
#   em-transformation-service         -> imported as the template scaffold, REMOVED again 2026-08: upstream
#                                        builds against metldata 5.x (the schemapack line, released from the
#                                        `schemapack` branch), which cannot co-resolve with the workspace's
#                                        integrated metldata 4.x line (DSKit caps `<5`). Upstream development
#                                        continues standalone; re-import (history-preserving) when the
#                                        workspace moves to the schemapack line.
#   charts                            -> imported once (deploy/), then REMOVED from the sync: the monorepo
#                                        restructured deploy/ to the ADR-0031 layout (base/ -> charts/ghga-common,
#                                        per-service charts generated), so upstream commits no longer apply as
#                                        patches. Upstream library changes are ported SEMANTICALLY into
#                                        deploy/charts/ghga-common + the generator instead — see
#                                        docs/migration/runbook.md.
# Retired: upstream repo ARCHIVED (read-only); the monorepo is now the source of truth. The row
# is REMOVED rather than kept, because an archived repo still clones fine — a sync would succeed
# as a permanent no-op, and a live row wrongly implies an upstream that still moves. Each was
# verified fully synced first (runbook: "Verifying a repo is fully synced"). Last upstream commit
# merged here, with the member version it carried:
#   auth-service           -> services/auth-service           7e53ecb "Migrate to httpx2 (#158)" 2026-08-07, 10.0.2
#   ghga-event-schemas     -> libs/ghga-event-schemas         0e1ba03 "Upload Box Size Limit (#78)" 2026-05-04, 13.0.0
#   ghga-datasteward-kit   -> tools/ghga-datasteward-kit      7d70c58 "Httpx2 migration (#86)" 2026-08-07, 5.4.2
#   data-portal            -> frontend/data-portal            ccc8676 "Update dependencies (#356)" 2026-08-10, 2.5.15
#                             (JS toolchain, separate pnpm lockfile)
#   epic-docs              -> docs/epics                      fcb9b94 "Complete README (#171)" 2026-08-12 (= archived tip)
#                             (planning docs, no code; outside the libs/*, services/*, tools/* globs,
#                             so not a uv workspace member)
#   access-request-service -> services/access-request-service 6af2b32 "Migrate to httpx2 (#57)" 2026-08-07, 8.0.2
#                             The one later upstream commit, 041d1f21 "Update template and dependencies
#                             (#58)" 2026-08-10 (= release 8.0.3), was NOT merged: apart from the version
#                             bump it is only dropped boilerplate (lock/requirements*.txt,
#                             .pyproject_generation/, a ruff rev: pin in the per-repo pre-commit config).
#                             The bump was ported by hand instead, so the member here reads 8.0.3 while
#                             the last merged commit carried 8.0.2.
#   work-package-service   -> services/work-package-service   4a61871 "Migrate to httpx2 (#72)" 2026-08-07, 11.1.1
#   ghga-registry-service  -> services/ghga-registry-service  510a085 "Update lock file for cryptography 50" 2026-08-07, 5.0.2
#                             The one later upstream commit, 7d536b7 "Sparse index (#28)"
#                             2026-08-11 (= release 5.0.3), was NOT merged: its content was ported
#                             by hand here instead (387b1f7c + 2dd9172f), so the member reads 5.0.3
#                             while the last merged commit carried 5.0.2.
#   mass                   -> services/mass                   32dd385 "Migrate to httpx2 (#51)" 2026-07-31, 7.0.2
#   hexkit                 -> libs/hexkit                     ad3c710 "Add observability tools docs (#251)" 2026-08-07, 9.0.1
#                             The member here reads 9.0.3: the docs move (ADR-0039) changed its
#                             `Documentation` URL and README, which ship in the wheel metadata, so
#                             the drift gate required a bump (9.0.2 is spent on TestPyPI).
#                             Its docs site moved to ghga-de.github.io/ghga/hexkit; the archived
#                             repo still serves ghga-de.github.io/hexkit as redirects to it.
#   file-services-backend  -> services/{dcs,ekss,fis,ifrs,pcs,ucs}
#                             c3d833f "Migrate to httpx2 (#218)" 2026-08-07, the one commit that
#                             touched all six subtrees, carrying dcs 10.3.0, ekss 5.3.0,
#                             fis 12.0.0, ifrs 7.4.0, pcs 6.4.0, ucs 15.2.0. The only repo imported
#                             partially: six rows, one per services/<svc> subtree flattened to top
#                             level. Feature branches stay unmerged on the archived repo (newest
#                             fix/cleanup_s3_connection_crash 2026-07-31, plus three ucs/* GSI
#                             branches); none reached main, so none were ever in scope for the sync.
#                             services/ucs additionally carries monorepo-only work never upstreamed
#                             (017c7dd9, splitting the missing-S3-multipart-upload log level by
#                             FileUpload state).
#   notification-service   -> services/notification-service   0c40356 "Migrate to httpx2 (#37)" 2026-08-06, 7.0.1
#   notification-orchestration-service -> services/notification-orchestration-service
#                             services/notification-orchestration-service additionally carries
#                             monorepo-only work never upstreamed (c53f1261, pointing the portal
#                             link at `access-request-manager/` rather than `access-requests/`).
#   dataset-information-service -> services/dataset-information-service
#   well-known-value-service -> services/well-known-value-service
#                             Both keep unmerged feature branches on the archived repo (newest
#                             dataset-information-service/feature/backport_dhi and
#                             well-known-value-service/feature/backport_dhi, both 2026-06-05);
#                             none reached main, so none were ever in scope for the sync.
#   auth-km-jobs           -> tools/auth-km-jobs              83ff924 "Update dependencies (#21)" 2026-01-14, 0.2.1
#                             main was its only branch ever, so nothing was out of scope.
#                             tools/auth-km-jobs additionally carries monorepo-only work never
#                             upstreamed: testcontainer-based test fixtures (upstream's tests
#                             expected Vault and MongoDB already running on localhost), the
#                             `run` -> `auth-km-jobs` console-script rename, and the ADR-0033
#                             capability markers.
#   dlq-service            -> services/dlq-service            42d67fd "Migrate to httpx2 (#20)" 2026-07-31, 4.1.1
#                             Every PR but one was merged: #19 "Add script to republish dead
#                             letters" (feature/dlq-script, 2026-07-21) was closed UNMERGED
#                             upstream, and feature/backport_dhi is a stray branch with no PR
#                             (the DHI swap landed as #17), so neither was ever in scope for
#                             the sync.
#   reverse-transpiler-service -> services/reverse-transpiler-service
#                             All ten PRs were merged; feature/backport_dhi (a 2.3.0 backport
#                             superseded by #9's 3.0.0 DHI swap) and fix/update_dependencies
#                             (#5, merged as a squash) are stale leftovers, never in scope.
#                             services/reverse-transpiler-service additionally carries
#                             monorepo-only work never upstreamed: a writable /tmp for
#                             spreadsheet serialization (431690a2, chart values only).
#   ghga-arcticfreeze      -> libs/ghga-arcticfreeze          c391587 "python version from 3.10" 2026-08-20, 1.0.0
#                             The later upstream commits 754fa9c "workflows updated", c92670a
#                             "template update" and their merge 7186ffc (#2) all 2026-08-20, touch
#                             only dropped boilerplate (.github/, lock/, .template/,
#                             .pyproject_generation/, the per-repo pre-commit config). The member
#                             here reads 1.1.2: the PyPI lane (#83) raised the floor to Python 3.11
#                             and repointed the project URLs to the monorepo, released as 1.1.1.
#                             NB: PyPI also carries the pre-rename dist `arcticfreeze` 0.1.1 — same
#                             import package, so the two cannot share a venv.
#   ghga-jsonsubschema     -> libs/ghga-jsonsubschema         b7a7cda "relax the required python version (#16)" 2026-08-20, 0.1.2
#                             All PRs were merged; feature/improve-package-quality-gsi-2374 is a
#                             stale leftover of #15 (squash-merged), superseded by #16, never in
#                             scope. The member here reads 0.2.0 after the same PyPI-lane changes.
#   archive-test-bed       -> testbed                         36f6cf1 "Release 14 and the leftover from 13 (#168)" 2026-08-11
#                             carrying 22.0.0+2026-04-02. Synced as 3cac63c3 and squash-merged
#                             in #190, so no rewritten SHA of it is on dev. #167 "TBAAS - Test
#                             Bed as a Service" was closed UNMERGED upstream; all feature branches
#                             were deleted before archiving. Its GitHub Pages site (service
#                             versions read from the compose file) was disabled too: the kind
#                             setup replaced that compose file here, so it could not be rebuilt.
#   ghga-service-commons   -> libs/ghga-service-commons       0f67ae4 "Switch to httpx2 (#83)" 2026-07-28, 8.0.0
#                             The six upstream commits with no counterpart here touch only
#                             dropped boilerplate: five .github/ or .devcontainer/ edits
#                             (2023-2024) and abf2ece "bump patch version" 2026-05-12
#                             (.pyproject_generation/). fix/proxy-no-proxy-and-ca-bundle is a
#                             leftover of #80 (squash-merged), update_deps_for_starlette_vuln a
#                             stale 5.0.0 dependency bump with no PR; neither was in scope. The
#                             member here reads 8.1.1 after the PyPI lane (#83), released as 8.1.0.
#   ghga-connector         -> tools/ghga-connector            a9d9618 "Migrate to httpx2 (#153)" 2026-08-07, 3.1.1
#                             The three upstream commits with no counterpart here touch only
#                             dropped boilerplate (two Dockerfile edits in 2022, one .github/ in
#                             2024). All PRs were merged except #146 (superseded by #149) and the
#                             CI experiments #99 and #100; feature/ubox and
#                             fix/transport_logic_issues are leftovers of #139 and #126. The
#                             maintenance lines release-3.0.x (3.0.2) and v1 (1.8.0) stay frozen
#                             there; a fix to them would branch from the release tag here.
#                             tools/ghga-connector additionally carries monorepo-only work never
#                             upstreamed (GSI-2574, 8ab35a1c to 94f0bee4: asynchronous encryption,
#                             no decryptor module and no passphrase argument, reworked request
#                             error handling), which made it 4.0.0; it reads 4.0.1 after the PyPI
#                             lane (#83), released as 4.0.0.
#   state-management-service -> services/state-management-service
#                             620500c "Replace Debian Dockerfile with DHI and bump version to
#                             5.0.0 (#28)" 2026-05-22, 5.0.0. The one upstream commit with no
#                             counterpart here, #9 "Update lock files for starlette vuln"
#                             2024-10-30, touches only dropped boilerplate (lock/, the per-repo
#                             pre-commit config). All PRs were merged; more-endpoints-patch is a
#                             leftover of #19, merged into #18 and squash-merged with it, and
#                             feature/backport_dhi a 4.3.2 backport with no PR, superseded by
#                             #28's 5.0.0 DHI swap. Neither was ever in scope for the sync.
#   test-oidc-provider     -> services/test-oidc-provider     312d7b2 "Add ID token and CORS header
#                             defaults (#15)" 2025-05-12, 2.2.0. Every upstream commit has a
#                             counterpart here, and main was its only branch. All PRs were
#                             merged except #9 "Add log message to openid config endpoint",
#                             closed UNMERGED. services/test-oidc-provider additionally carries
#                             monorepo-only work never upstreamed: forwarding the full path where
#                             it builds its own URLs (ce48aa23, chart values only).
#   schemapack             -> libs/schemapack                 0c9117b "Feature/expose spec models
#                             (#60)" 2026-07-28, 4.3.0. The three upstream commits with no
#                             counterpart here, #27, #38 and #44, touch only dropped boilerplate
#                             (.devcontainer/, .template/, .github/), and main was its only
#                             branch. All PRs were merged except #26 (2024), #59 "Fix SchemaPack
#                             classes serialization" and #61 "dependency update plus relaxing
#                             the python version", closed UNMERGED. Neither left work behind:
#                             #59's serialization tests pass here unchanged, and #61's
#                             dependency change was made here instead (3d3d81c4).
#                             libs/schemapack reads 4.4.1 after the PyPI lane (#83), released
#   ghga-validator         -> tools/ghga-validator            308948a "Task/additional tests for
#                             validator gim 216 (#13)" 2024-02-21, 1.1.1. The two upstream
#                             commits with no counterpart here, #9 and #20, touch only
#                             .github/. All PRs were merged except #19, superseded by #20. Of
#                             the leftover branches, ten belong to merged PRs,
#                             feature/pydantic_update was superseded by #16, and
#                             task/modify_pypi (no PR) holds the 1.2.0 PyPI release's CI and
#                             lock changes plus a setuptools pin that linkml >=1.8 no longer
#                             needs. tools/ghga-validator reads 1.2.3 after the PyPI lane (#83),
#                             released as 1.2.2.
# Twenty-one archived tips are deliberately NOT merged — each is an archival/deprecation
# notice that belongs only on the retired repo: ghga-event-schemas a974e34, data-portal
# 0249482, access-request-service 1f2069d1, work-package-service 4b933c0,
# ghga-datasteward-kit f474eef (which also makes the PyPI console script print a
# final-release banner — wanted there, not here), file-services-backend 605be53 (root
# README and template only, so the partial rows would have filtered it to empty in any
# case), hexkit 245ca78 "Replace the docs site with redirects to the monorepo (#253)",
# notification-service 00ca3db1, notification-orchestration-service 285dc85f,
# dataset-information-service 5afbde4, well-known-value-service 282b4be (all four "Add
# deprecation note"), auth-km-jobs f27562b "Add retirement note (#22)", dlq-service 4646433
# "Add deprecation note (#21)", reverse-transpiler-service b428f91 "Add deprecation note
# (#11)", ghga-arcticfreeze b8d3b65 "Add archival note (#3)", ghga-jsonsubschema c7dae8c
# "Add archival note (#17)", archive-test-bed df4d323 "Add archival note (#169)",
# ghga-service-commons 7e434b8 "Add note about archival (#84)", ghga-connector c6e672d
# "Add archival note (#154)", schemapack d851f16 "Add archival note (#62)" and
# ghga-validator 42a3123 "Add archival note". Those last fifteen are the only tips that
# would NOT have filtered to empty: hexkit's is mostly redirect tooling on paths the import
# drops (.github/, scripts/, .template/, .gitignore), the next four, ghga-connector's and
# ghga-validator's touch nothing else but .readme_generation/ and .template/, schemapack's
# nothing else but .readme_generation/, lock/, scripts/ and the per-repo pre-commit
# config, auth-km-jobs', dlq-service's, ghga-arcticfreeze's, archive-test-bed's and
# ghga-service-commons' touch nothing but the README, ghga-jsonsubschema's nothing else but the dropped uv.lock, and
# reverse-transpiler-service's bundles a template refresh whose kept-path parts the
# monorepo has already replaced centrally (the per-repo [tool.ruff] tables and the
# per-member .gitignore, dropped in 9ddc8284) — yet each also adds a "this repo has moved"
# banner to the README, which is kept: an upstream-only notice, wrong to carry here, where
# that README is the package's own.
# adrs is archived too but never had a row: it was copied once, flattened, into
# docs/adrs as ADR-0001 to ADR-0024 (docs/adrs/adrNNN_name.md -> docs/adrs/0NNN-name.md).
# Libraries (source-coupled, consumed via [tool.uv.sources] workspace = true)
lib
# Standalone services
service
# CLIs and jobs
# ghga-transpiler: the integrated/compatible line is v2 (2.x, no schemapack dep), NOT main (3.x).
tool
